Local staging change:
  Mach-O install name changed from ./libskiko-macos-arm64.dylib to
  @rpath/libskiko-macos-arm64.dylib, then ad-hoc signed. Code and data sections
  are otherwise the Maven artifact's bytes.

Staged SHA-256:
  a4969df53851c418a5f0d79f98cb1d4ff252675a3f5a9eed3570c5282bae8b8b

License retrieval provenance:
  LICENSE-SKIKO.txt and NOTICE-SKIKO.txt are unchanged copies of LICENSE and
  NOTICE at the Skiko source commit above, fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com.
  LICENSE-SKIA.txt is an unchanged copy of LICENSE at the Skia source commit
  above, fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com.
  thirdparty/framework-res/LICENSE was absent when these notices were added;
  no locally generated resource-build license was reused for Skiko.

  THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt preserves upstream texts for the static macOS JVM
  dependencies listed by Skiko v0.150.2 skiko/build.gradle.kts: ICU, HarfBuzz,
  libpng, libjpeg-turbo (including README.ijg), WebP, zlib, Expat, DNG SDK and
  Piex; it also includes Wuffs and its Skia integration notice for image decode.
  Each section records its exact source URL or archive member. Gitiles TEXT
  responses were base64-decoded, not rewritten or replaced by guessed licenses.

  HarfBuzz, libpng, WebP and zlib texts came from the pinned upstream archive:
    https://github.com/JetBrains/skia/releases/download/m150-a3f509bf52/Skia-m150-a3f509bf52-macos-Release-arm64.zip
  Archive SHA-256 (matches the GitHub release asset digest):
    76b4983295cf50cbc955ff111ac9211a5057fe1d13a8552431b8d559a5a19584
  Other dependency texts came from the revisions pinned in that Skia commit's
  DEPS file, or from its own third_party integration files. This archive was
  used only to retrieve license texts; the shipped dylib comes from Maven.

Scope and reproducibility caveats:
  The Skia version and static-dependency inventory are derived from the pinned
  upstream Skiko release sources, not an independent reproducible build or a
  binary-level inventory. Upstream permits platform-specific dependency
  overrides; no claim is made that these source settings attest every byte of
  the published binary. The Maven runtime jar supplies no complete aggregate
  third-party notice, so the source notices are retained here explicitly.
  Upgrading the dylib requires refreshing the source pins and these notices.
  Homebrew Brotli is a separate JRE dependency, not this prebuilt's provenance;
  gen_third_party_notices.sh reads its MIT license from the linked Brotli keg.
